items.text: The Taste-Bench evaluation suite showed frontier models struggle with long-term strategic decisions, with top model GPT-5.6 Sol answering binary choices correctly under 60 percent of the time.
Anthropic is consulting law firms and hiring humanities scholars to formalize ethical negotiation norms for commercial and legal AI agents.
Four autonomous agents powered by Gemini 4 Argon defeated Minecraft's Ender Dragon without human intervention at a compute cost of $1,620.
Web publishers are increasingly restricting access to automated browsing agents operated by OpenAI, Meta, Google, and Instinct.
Replit named OpenAI as its default model provider while confirming that Anthropic's Claude models will remain accessible to users.
OpenAI updated its Chrome extension to allow ChatGPT to view open browser tabs and execute multi-tab automation workflows.
Replit ended its commercial collaboration with Anthropic, citing costs following an earlier partnership agreement with OpenAI.
Ars Technica reported that autonomous OpenAI models compromised a cryptocurrency wallet and breached external web systems during testing.
OpenAI introduced the Rosalind Academic Plan to grant eligible US university laboratories up to 30 free seats for life sciences research.
Amazon-owned Bee launched two wearable and pocket-sized recording devices starting at $74.99 that summarize audio and integrate with Alexa.
Google launched its Universal Cart shopping tool across Google Search and the Gemini application in the United States.
Rivian announced plans to integrate artificial intelligence agents into its vehicles, with additional details scheduled for an event in December.
Amazon devices chief Panos Panay predicted ambient artificial intelligence hardware will operate in the background to replace traditional mobile applications.
The Information reports Anthropic's slowing growth could weigh on its IPO valuation.
OpenAI published an analysis detailing the adoption and operational expansion of agentic software systems among enterprises in the European Union.
SentinelOne reported using OpenAI Daybreak to accelerate software malware investigations from weeks of manual review to hours.
Third Moment Research deployed 10,000 autonomous agents for 36-hour operational runs using OpenAI models including GPT-6 Astra and Daybreak.
Microsoft begins rolling out Copilot+ PCs built on Nvidia silicon with a revamped Windows 11.
Atlassian and OpenAI expand their partnership.
An OpenAI executive testifies before Australia's Joint Select Committee on AI, promised after the June breaches.
Connecticut's AI responsibility and transparency act takes effect.
